about.description: XBR is a commodity perpetual listed on Phemex, tracking Crude Oil (Brent), margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 4h. Up to 100× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
